description: Generates sine tones, sine sweeps and noise for testing and alignment, with the output level printed in decibels

params.text: Turns the output level up and down in 0.1dB steps, from 0dB, which is 10V peak, down to -96dB
Moves the sine frequency, by whatever interval STEP is set to
Sets how long one sweep takes, 0.1 seconds to 60 seconds, in steps of 0.1 seconds below 10 seconds and 1 second above
Chooses what comes out while SWEEP is at OFF: SINE a sine at the set frequency, WH white noise, PK pink noise
OFF leaves the tone to TONE; LOG sweeps a sine from 20Hz to 20000Hz at a constant number of octaves per second, LIN sweeps it over the same span at a constant number of hertz per second
Sets how far one detent of FREQ moves the sine: 3RD one third of an octave, OCT one octave, LOG one semitone
Starts a sweep, and while ON is at MOM produces the tone for as long as it is held down
ON leaves the output running all the time; MOM gives output only while TRIG is held or the TRIG jack is high, and makes each sweep a single pass rather than a loop

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V starts a sweep, and while the voltage stays above 1V and ON is at MOM the tone is produced

outputs.text: The tone or sweep at the level LEVEL sets, and 0V whenever nothing is being produced

notes: changing TONE, SWEEP, STEP or ON resets the sine frequency to 1000Hz, or to 1046.5Hz when STEP is at LOG, and stops any sweep in progress
at 3RD and OCT the frequency comes from the standard third-octave series; 3RD covers 20Hz to 20000Hz a step at a time and OCT covers 31.5Hz to 16000Hz three steps at a time
at LOG the frequency is free between 20.6Hz and 19912Hz
scroll over the display to move the REF reading up and down in 0.1dB steps; that changes only what the display prints, not the output
pink noise is approximated with three one-pole filters on white noise, so check the spectrum before using it for precise measurement
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel or the display

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
